about.title: Systems Engineer
about.description: An engineer who designs interfaces and AI.
about.manifest: I learned to [code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_development) just to build websites, and now [understanding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_experience) how [people and machines behave](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Mechanistic_interpretability) is the part I'm best at.

layout.projectsLead: So, what do you want to see?
layout.credits: Loosely designed in [Figma](https://figma.com) and coded in [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) and [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/) by yours truly. Built with [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) and [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/), deployed with [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com/). All text is set in the [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) typeface.
